title: Update the full tangent image for a tensor plus move
statement: For arbitrary finite V1,V2,V3 over F2 and the integer identity abc+def=a(b+e)c+ae(f-c)+(d-a)ef, the source proves I_new=I_old+T(a,e,f-c) and e_new-e_old in I_new. The new binary point lifts unrestrictedly toZ/4 iff the old residual class lies in this middle-term tangent image modulo I_old. Vanishing/dependent factor vectors are included.
